title: Refresh Token Strategies
description: Design secure refresh token strategies with rotation, revocation, and sliding expiration for modern applications.
longDescription: This module covers refresh token strategies in depth including token rotation, sliding expiration, absolute expiration, token revocation, and best practices for storing refresh tokens securely. You will learn to implement refresh token flows that balance security with user experience.
whatYouLearn: Implement refresh token flows with automatic token renewal
Use token rotation to detect and prevent token theft
Apply sliding expiration for improved security
Implement token revocation for logout and security incidents
Store refresh tokens securely in HTTP-only cookies and secure storage
